heading: Built around you,

lead: We believe that since every client is unique, every client portfolio should be unique. That conviction shapes how we work — and the two ways we serve.

models.title: Custom-designed portfolios
models.body: Managed by your personal advisor and built to your life — integrating tax planning, your risk tolerance, and even your social and ethical priorities into the portfolio's design.

models.title: Company-sponsored SMA portfolios
models.body: For those best served by institutional scale, three separately managed strategies run by VEM's founding partners — with twenty-plus years of institutional portfolio management.

note: Both are held to the same fiduciary standard — your best interest, above all else.
